messages:
Maya (Growth): Quick creative request for Tuesdays launch push  tiny scope: 1 hero (1200x628 light+dark), 3 social tiles (1080x1080) with A/B copy, and a printable 1-pager (A4) with a small benchmark snapshot (latency vs unit cost). Need handoff by Fri noon PT.
Noah (PM): Prioritize hero + social variants. Keep the benchmark visual simple: sparkline + one delta bar. Canonical numbers coming in a sec.
Ira (Design): Got it. Voice = technical-friendly? Any mandatory shots (product screenshot) or pure data tiles?
Maya (Growth): Mix: one product-shot tile, two data/cta tiles. Tagline: "Serve better LLMs  lower latency, lower cost." CTA: "Register".
asset-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/unique123/serve-smaller-pack 1: view access.
Ira (Design): Will deliver 2 hero options + social comps. Export naming please?
Noah (PM): Use: launch/servebetter/<asset>-<variant>-<size>-v1.png. Example: launch/servebetter/hero-bold-1200x628-v1.png
Priya (Localization): We'll need editable text layers on separate pages for EN/FR/DE and +25% space for DE. Also request a CSV with keys for copy and alt-text.
Sam (Legal): Quick flag: add footer: "© 2026 Redwood Inference" and if partner logos appear, confirm permissions before export. Also include a small footnote area for benchmark source.
Ira (Design): Noted. Accessibility: using colorblind-safe palettes, 4.5:1 contrast for body copy. Min 16px when scaled to 1080x1080.
Maya (Growth): Great. ETA from design?
Ira (Design): Comps by Thu 10am PT, first exports by Fri 11am PT, final handoff Fri noon. Will add alt-text drafts and a one-line social caption per tile in the handoff sheet.
Maya (Growth): Perfect  please @marketing when hero PNG/GIF is uploaded so we can queue paid promos.
